figures.caption: Figure 1. Examples of expected outputs from the generate_figures function. (A) Venn diagram depicting the overlap between genes in seed set1 and seed set2. (B) Jitter plot showing the categories of genes identified by propagating seed set 1 and 2, including seed genes and newly identified genes, stratified by statistical significance (p < 0.05). (C) Bar plots showing the number of significant seed genes and newly identified from the individual propagation analyses. Network propagation output dataset used to generate Figure 1B-C is provided in Table S1.
